description: Search Allerhande, Albert Heijn's recipe collection. Dutch search terms work best, e.g. 'pasta', 'stamppot', 'kip curry'; a recipe matches when it has all the words. filters narrows results to recipes matching all of them, e.g. ['vegetarian', 'quick', 'italian']: a label (easy, quick, budget, healthy, light), course (main_course, lunch, dessert, ...), dish (pasta, soup, salad, ...), main ingredient (meat, fish, ...), diet (vegan, gluten_free, ...), occasion, season, cooking method (oven, airfryer, ...) or cuisine (italian, asian, ...). query may be left out to browse by filters alone. sort orders results: relevance (default), newest, popular. Returns id, title, url, cook_minutes, servings, courses, nutri_score, rating, and corrected_query when AH fixed a typo. Use the id with ah_get_recipe for ingredients and steps. When you mention a product or recipe from the result, link its name to its url.

filters.description: Only recipes matching all of these, e.g. ["vegetarian", "quick"]

name: ah_search_recipes
